# @three-ws/mocap

> Motion capture as an API. Turn webcam/video into face, pose, and hand animation clips, then save, share, and replay them on any three.ws avatar.

@three-ws/mocap is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/mocap`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-mocap/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-mocap/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-mocap/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-mocap/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
